property.text: The encode_account function MUST hash the account code using keccak256 before RLP encoding. forall (account): encode_account(account, storage_root) includes keccak256(account.code) not account.code directly.

reachability.notes: If raw code is used instead of its hash, encoding size and content would differ from spec, causing state root divergence.

property.severity_justification: Encoding raw code instead of its keccak256 hash would cause state root mismatch with all other implementations, leading to consensus failure.

property.text: The raw_account_data input to encode_account MUST be a valid Account instance containing nonce (Uint), balance (U256), and code (bytes) fields.

reachability.notes: This is an internal type safety requirement. Callers of encode_account are internal EL components.

property.severity_justification: Impacts correctness of internal state handling but requires an internal caller to pass invalid data.

property.text: The storage_root parameter to encode_account MUST be a 32-byte Root value representing the Merkle root of the account's storage trie.

reachability.notes: Internal parameter validation. Callers are trusted internal components.

property.severity_justification: Internal parameter constraint. A wrong-sized storage_root would produce incorrect encoding.

property.text: EMPTY_ACCOUNT MUST be a module-level frozen/immutable constant. Once constructed, EMPTY_ACCOUNT.nonce == 0, EMPTY_ACCOUNT.balance == 0, and EMPTY_ACCOUNT.code == b'' MUST hold for the entire process lifetime.

reachability.notes: If EMPTY_ACCOUNT is mutable, runtime modification could corrupt empty account detection, causing state bloat or incorrect pruning.

property.severity_justification: Mutable EMPTY_ACCOUNT could cause incorrect empty account detection, leading to state corruption or divergence between implementations.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Internal implementation issue. Not directly exploitable externally but could cause consensus divergence.

property.text: EMPTY_ACCOUNT field values MUST be exactly: nonce = Uint(0), balance = U256(0), code = b''. No other values are acceptable for the empty account sentinel.

reachability.notes: Construction-time constant definition. Any deviation would be a build-time or initialization error.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect EMPTY_ACCOUNT values would cause all empty account comparisons to fail, leading to state bloat.

property.text: The Address type alias MUST enforce exactly 20 bytes (Bytes20). Any deserialized Address value with length != 20 bytes MUST be rejected.

reachability.notes: Malicious P2P peer can send blocks or transactions with Address values of incorrect length. Failure to enforce size constraints could cause buffer issues.

property.severity_justification: Accepting oversized or undersized addresses could cause state corruption or consensus divergence between implementations with different size enforcement.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC demonstrating acceptance of an Address with length != 20 bytes via P2P.

property.text: The Root and VersionedHash type aliases MUST enforce exactly 32 bytes (Hash32). Any deserialized Root or VersionedHash value with length != 32 bytes MUST be rejected.

reachability.notes: Malicious P2P peer can send blocks with Root or VersionedHash values of incorrect length.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect hash sizes could cause state trie corruption or consensus divergence.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC demonstrating acceptance of a Root or VersionedHash with length != 32 bytes.

property.text: The Bloom type alias MUST enforce exactly 256 bytes (Bytes256). Any deserialized Bloom value with length != 256 bytes MUST be rejected.

reachability.notes: Malicious P2P peer can send blocks with Bloom filters of incorrect size.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect Bloom size could cause log filtering failures or consensus divergence.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC demonstrating acceptance of a Bloom with length != 256 bytes.

property.text: The EIP-7702 Authorization dataclass MUST contain exactly the fields: chain_id (U256), address (Address), nonce (U64), y_parity (U8), r (U256), s (U256). No additional or missing fields are permitted.

reachability.notes: Malformed Authorization tuples received via P2P or transaction pool must be rejected. Extra or missing fields could cause parsing errors.

property.severity_justification: Accepting malformed Authorization tuples could cause crashes or undefined behavior during signature verification.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC demonstrating acceptance of an Authorization with extra/missing fields.

property.text: All data received from P2P peers MUST be fully validated before processing. This includes: account RLP encoding structure, deposit data format, Authorization signature format, and requests hash computation inputs. No unvalidated P2P data may influence state transitions.

reachability.notes: P2P peers are completely untrusted and can send arbitrary data. Any missing validation is a potential vulnerability.

property.severity_justification: Unvalidated P2P input reaching state transition logic could cause crashes, state corruption, or consensus divergence.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC demonstrating unvalidated P2P data causing node crash or state corruption.
